name: Tecnam P2006T
summary: Italian lightweight four-seat twin with Rotax engines, certified in the US in 2010 and widely used as an economical multi-engine trainer.

engines: Two small Rotax engines in slim nacelles
fuselage: Slim cabin with a large curved wraparound windscreen
tail: Tall swept fin with a low horizontal stabilizer

tellTales: Small shoulder-wing twin with tiny engines
Large curved windscreen on a short nose
Upturned wingtips and a tall swept fin

confusedWith.howToTell: The DA42 is a low-wing composite twin with a T-tail; the P2006T has a high wing and a conventional tail.
The Seminole is a low-wing twin with a T-tail; the P2006T is a high-wing twin with a low tail.
The P2012 is much bigger, with nine seats, fixed gear and large round windows; the P2006T is a small four-seater.
The P.68 is larger with a long pointed nose and fixed gear; the P2006T is smaller with a rounded nose and retractable gear.
